turn.speaker: sara
turn.text: The addition of wildflowers, whether daisies, lavender, or any of the others, can bring life and depth to our dishes. They can add texture and color to our cooking, and the visual appeal of the addition to our dish can also enhance the overall flavor and appearance. It's a creative and versatile choice, and we can experiment with different wildflower combinations to find the one that works best for our specific dish.
